member.name: M:Cytoscape.NET.LayoutModule.initBreadthfirst(Microsoft.FSharp.Core.FSharpFunc{Cytoscape.NET.Layout,Cytoscape.NET.Layout})
member.summary: initializes a layout of type "breadthfirst" applying the givin layout option function. The "breadthfirst" layout puts nodes in a hierarchy, based on a breadthfirst traversal of the graph. It is best suited to trees and forests in its default top-down mode, and it is best suited to DAGs in its circle mode.
